We present to you a unique Cuban blend , crafted in the same way as a premium cigar mix — using cigar leaves: Ligero, Viso, two types of Seco , and a wrapper leaf. name: Serbetli – Fresh Pineapple – 250g
description: Description Serbetli made on the basis of honey, which gives it a slightly sweet natural taste. The cut of tobacco is quite large, the leaf is very well impregnated. The main difference from tobaccos of other manufacturers is heat resistance and high humidity, which allows you to enjoy the taste longer and heat the tobacco for more smokiness, while the tobacco does not taste bitter at all. This tobacco is great for beginners as it is very easy to make without fear of burning. Sherbetli is also famous for its very high smokiness, much higher than competitors such as Al Fakher or Nakhla. The Serbetli flavor line initially consisted of only 20 flavors, but in 2014 the line expanded significantly and now includes more than 60 flavors. Tobacco is produced in Turkey, in the city of Trabzon. Possible packaging is 50 and 250 grams. Serbetli is a great alternative to Starbuzz, but with a more natural taste. Of the advantages of tobacco – its smoke and heat resistance, of the minuses – low strength.

The adjusted inner diameter allows for a smooth flow and good tightening behavior, coupled with the simple blow-off system leaving no expectations unfulfilled. New materials: The high-quality coating of the plate and the stainless steel base set the Sphere 2 apart from its predecessor and bring that extra bit of quality. Safety: Fit-optimized seal, as well as rounded spikes, make your smoking experience not only more beautiful but also safer. +LINE : The Sphere 2 also has additional accessories in the +LINE, such as seals or orbs.

Ideal for all types of tobacco, the Alpha Bowl Doll combines aesthetic design, practicality, and durability — delivering consistently smooth and balanced smoking sessions. The bowl is perfect for both smoking on Kaloud Lotus and smoking on foil.

The Steamulation Cooling Diffuser combines numerous functions in its compact design that enhance and optimize shisha enjoyment in a unique way. The Steamulation Cooling Diffuser is compatible with all current Steamulation models: Steamulation Superior, Pro X I – III, Prime Pro X I and II, Pure and Pure One, Pro X Mini, Classic, Prime, Xpansion, Ultimate and Ultimate One. name: Serbetli – Strawberry Milkshake – 250g
description: Description Serbetli made on the basis of honey, which gives it a slightly sweet natural taste. The cut of tobacco is quite large, the leaf is very well impregnated. The main difference from tobaccos of other manufacturers is heat resistance and high humidity, which allows you to enjoy the taste longer and heat the tobacco for more smokiness, while the tobacco does not taste bitter at all. This tobacco is great for beginners as it is very easy to make without fear of burning. Sherbetli is also famous for its very high smokiness, much higher than competitors such as Al Fakher or Nakhla. The Serbetli flavor line initially consisted of only 20 flavors, but in 2014 the line expanded significantly and now includes more than 60 flavors. Tobacco is produced in Turkey, in the city of Trabzon. Possible packaging is 50 and 250 grams. Serbetli is a great alternative to Starbuzz, but with a more natural taste. Of the advantages of tobacco – its smoke and heat resistance, of the minuses – low strength.

description: Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Buckthorn Orange Sea Buckthorn • Juicy Orange • Burley & Virginia Blend • 100g Experience a vibrant explosion of Siberian sunshine. Sarma Buckthorn Orange 100g is a sophisticated, high-contrast blend that pairs the exotic, oil-rich tartness of wild sea buckthorn with the familiar, zesty sweetness of ripe oranges. This profile captures the essence of a traditional northern wellness tea—tangy, slightly floral, and bracingly fresh. Built on Sarma’s signature Burley and Virginia dark leaf base, it delivers a medium-strength session with exceptional heat resistance. The earthy tobacco undertones provide a warm foundation that balances the fruit’s high-voltage acidity, producing dense, aromatic clouds that maintain their complex, “superfood” brightness from the first pull to the very last.

name: Sarma Serviceberry 100G
description: Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Juneberry (Irga) Northern Irga Berry • Honeyed Tartness • Burley & Virginia Blend • 100g Discover the rare, rustic charm of the Siberian wilderness. Sarma Juneberry 100g (known as “Irga” in Russia) is a sophisticated tribute to the hardy northern berry that sits elegantly between a sweet blueberry and a tart Concord grape. name: Serbetli – Istanbul nights – 250g
description: Description Serbetli made on the basis of honey, which gives it a slightly sweet natural taste. The cut of tobacco is quite large, the leaf is very well impregnated. The main difference from tobaccos of other manufacturers is heat resistance and high humidity, which allows you to enjoy the taste longer and heat the tobacco for more smokiness, while the tobacco does not taste bitter at all. This tobacco is great for beginners as it is very easy to make without fear of burning. Sherbetli is also famous for its very high smokiness, much higher than competitors such as Al Fakher or Nakhla. The Serbetli flavor line initially consisted of only 20 flavors, but in 2014 the line expanded significantly and now includes more than 60 flavors. Tobacco is produced in Turkey, in the city of Trabzon. Possible packaging is 50 and 250 grams. Serbetli is a great alternative to Starbuzz, but with a more natural taste. Of the advantages of tobacco – its smoke and heat resistance, of the minuses – low strength.

name: WOOKAH MINI – MAUVE w/ Misty Base
description: WOOKAH Mini Body Mauve combines the natural charm of wood with a dash of human creativity through a unique, colorful finish. This WOOKAH piece was created to evoke natural wonders such as summer berries, morganite stones, aster flowers, or an early sundawn over a misty meadow. With its delicate appearance, it brings a fresh and contemporary touch to any interior. WOOKAH Mini includes a quick lock system , a technical solution, which enables quick and convenient mounting of the WOOKAH body to the WOOKAH vase. With just a short movement you can match the two elements. It also has a ground joint connection. The valve adapter has been equipped with an additional grommet, which means you don’t have to worry about the valve or the ball falling out of the adapter. WOOKAH Mini Vase Misty Smooth – the inspiration for the vase itself, as well as for the name, was a hazy morning, delighting with its subtlety and delicacy. The method used to produce this vase is sandblasting, also known as matting, which provides a modern and original effect. The distinctness of the Misty Smooth vase derives from the fact that its surface is completely smooth and lacks cuts. It includes 1.4301 (V2A) stainless steel thread with WOOKAH engraving. Each Smooth Vase is unique and handmade, therefore the weight of each product may vary. This fact does not affect the quality of WOOKAH. Quick lock system – enables quick and convenient mounting of the WOOKAH vase to the WOOKAH body. With just a short movement you can match the two elements.

The name comes from the word luminescence – the phenomenon of glowing. It is the first product in our portfolio of this kind. In the daylight it has a red-black color, while in the dark it glows green. To expose we recommend the use of a UV lamp or indirect daylight after which you will see a brief glow. With its extraordinary finish, it resembles an erupting volcano, but also overlapping waves. Gives a wonderful impression, especially in the dark rooms. It has a high quality 1.4301 (V2A) stainless steel tube mounted inside the mouthpiece. This metal part is highly durable, reduces the likelihood of corrosion and does not absorb smells. It is compatible with both versions of WOOKAH. name: WOOKAH – Chameleon
description: This exceptional Wookah Exclusive Chameleon Hookah set is another member of our unique line of Exclusive WOOKAH products that combine the seamless smoking experience with a sleek, modern look. It comes in an elegant suitcase as a full set consisting of body, vase, natural leather hose with connector, mouthpiece, WOOKAH Funnel Flow and WOOKAH Care Gloves . The polished metal elements not only exude a captivating brilliance but also set a new standard for shine and sophistication. Prepare to be mesmerized as these polished surfaces catch and reflect light, adding an exquisite touch of glamour to your experience. The Chameleon Body features a unique and mesmerizing design, with vibrant, shimmering colors that change depending on the angle of the light. Each body is handmade, making every piece one-of-a-kind.
